articles.title: American Express to break ground on tower next month at Two World Trade Center - major milestone for tragic site
articles.description: They'll break out the champagne downtown on July 9, when ground will be broken for the long-awaited American Express tower at Two World Trade Center. The public start of construction caps a quarter-century struggle to fully replace the Twin Towers and other buildings at the 16-acre site that were destroyed on 9/11.

articles.title: American couple gives $5.5 million for healthcare infra in US
articles.description: Brij and Sunita Agarwal have gifted USD 5.5 million to expand medical services in Houston. This significant donation will enhance clinical programs at St Luke's Health-Sugar Land Hospital. It will also fund a new Primary Care Community Clinic. The hospital's main patient tower will be renamed in their honor.
